LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_SectionTip: With play on, the first person key on one of your own colonists takes control of them: the mouse looks round, the movement keys walk, the left button does the main action on what the crosshair points at and the right button opens every order. Shift and the first person key, or the key on anyone else, only rides along as before.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_PlayTip: On: the first person key takes control of the one selected colonist of yours. Off: it only rides along in their head, as before.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_SensitivityTip: How far the view turns for each step of mouse movement while you control a colonist. The camera's "Invert up and down" option applies too.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_HintsTip: Shows what the left button would do on what the crosshair points at.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_CheatSheet: Show the controls once per session
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_CheatSheetTip: A line with the keys and buttons, for a few seconds the first time you take control in a session.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_AnyDistance: Left button works at any distance
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_AnyDistanceTip: Off: the left button only acts on things within arm's reach (walk up to them). The right-button menu always works at any distance.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_MoveInterrupt: Hold to walk away from a job
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_MoveInterruptTip: How long a movement key must be held before it stops the job the colonist is doing, so a brief tap doesn't cancel an order.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_Resume: Take control again after a reload
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_ResumeTip: In multiplayer every join point and resync reloads the game. On: you are back in control of the same colonist afterwards.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_HudScaleTip: Size of the first-person crosshair, hint, status line and messages.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_AutoNeedsTip: On: a colonist you control who becomes urgently hungry, exhausted or in need of a doctor eats, sleeps or goes to bed on their own and comes back to you after. Not while drafted; draft them to call them back early.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_SkillChecksTip: A ring round the crosshair during crafting, cooking, art and other skilled work: press the check key as the spark crosses the arc. A good press speeds the work and raises its quality, a miss slows it and lowers it, and walking away from a check counts as a miss. Off: the work runs as in the game.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_CheckLatencyTip: Taken off the time of each press to make up for display and input lag. Raise it if your presses land late.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_CheckSoundsTip: A tick as the ring appears and a sound for each result.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_ColourBlindTip: A dashed arc and a white great part with marks at its edges.
LanguageData.R3D_Fp_Settings_ShowHitChanceTip: While drafted, the game's own estimate of the chance to hit what the crosshair points at, next to the crosshair and in the hint. Firing in first person always uses the game's own odds.
